beats.say: Smart people don't work harder. They switch life from hard, past normal, to easy.
Here are the seven laws they follow.
One. Kidlin's Law. A problem in your head is fog. Write it on paper, and it's half solved.
beats.name: Kidlin's Law

beats.say: Two. Pareto's Law. Two in ten tasks drive most of your results. Do those first.
beats.name: Pareto's Law

beats.say: Three. Murphy's Law. What can go wrong, will. A late train. A flat battery. Plan for it once.
beats.name: Murphy's Law

beats.say: Four. Wilson's Law. Learn first. The money tends to follow, just later than the effort.
beats.name: Wilson's Law

beats.say: Five. Gilbert's Law. Asked to sort the report? Don't wait for instructions, or do just what's said. Propose the best way.
beats.name: Gilbert's Law

p.label: YOUR BOSS
p.prompt: Can you sort out the client report?

beats.say: Six. Falkland's Law. If you don't have to decide yet, don't. Waiting for facts beats rushing.
beats.name: Falkland's Law

beats.say: Seven. Hick's Law. More options make you slower to choose. Cut your choices to three.
beats.name: Hick's Law

beats.say: Which law do you break most? Comment the number, and follow for more.

p.label: LAWS
p.line1: Which law do you break most?
p.line2: Comment the number. Follow for more.
